The 05.12.26 bid tabulation reverses this package's two low rows: it records NDX at $1,924,851 and New-Com (TAB) at $3,152,033, but each bidder's own submitted Proposal Form states the opposite -- TAB's BuildingConnected header and letter both read $1,924,851, NDX's read $3,152,032.69. The proposal governs the tabulation. TAB is therefore the LOW bidder ($1,924,851 < Monument $2,296,000 < NDX $3,152,033), not the high one, and the earlier 'awarded sub was not the low bidder' flag on this package is withdrawn. TAB's 05.22.26 homework response restates the same $1,924,851 base bid, so the price is stable across their chain.

RFP-016 / RFP-022 LEVELING DEFECT: Sprinturf submitted a single combined Landscaping+Irrigation+Synthetic Turf price of $1,022,155 (their Proposal Form is headed 'Bid Proposal: Landscaping & Irrigation'; their descope file is named '016, 022 Irrigation + Synthetic Turf'). The tab enters that combined number once, under Landscaping & Irrigation only. Consequence: the RFP-022 row omits Sprinturf entirely, and the RFP-016 row compares a combined 016+022 bid against landscaping-only bids (BrightView $131,300, Black Canyon $111,275). Neither row levels correctly -- split or annotate before using either for award justification.
